tool_summary: Executes a command as another user, typically root, after authentication.
platform_notes: Flag set and behavior are effectively identical across GNU/Linux and BSD/macOS sudo implementations for the purposes of this ruleset.

rules.description: Any invocation of sudo executes a command with elevated privileges, typically as root. The wrapped command is not visible to commandant and may perform arbitrary, unbounded actions with root access.
rules.reversible_note: Reversibility depends entirely on the wrapped command, which commandant does not inspect. Treated as the worst case.
rules.notes: This tool blanket-flags all invocations because the wrapped command is opaque to commandant. A future iteration could unwrap and assess the wrapped command the way is_multiplexer tools are intended to be handled (see R-INS-05).
